Let's break down the main ways you can get started and interact with JustFoodForDogs in simple terms: Finding the Right Food & Amount: If you're unsure what to feed your dog or how much, we have a helpful tool called the Feeding Calculator. You can input your dog's details, and it will help you build a meal plan tailored to their needs. We also have Feeding Guides for general information, including a Puppy Feeding Guide. Our Food Types: We offer different types of food, primarily Fresh-Frozen, JustFresh, and Pantry Fresh. JustFresh recipes are made with ingredients like oats, brown rice, carrots, and kale, and come in a resealable pouch. Pantry Fresh recipes are very similar to our Fresh-Frozen options and are also shelf-stable for up to 2 years unopened. Both JustFresh and Pantry Fresh use high-quality, human-grade ingredients and are shelf-stable until opened, then need refrigeration. For a first-timer like me, what's the safest, easiest choice?

Agent response: That's a great question for a first-timer! To make it easiest and safest for your dog to start on our whole fresh food, I'd recommend considering our Variety Pack - Sampler Box (18 oz). It's specifically mentioned as a great option for dogs starting out, allowing your pet to try different recipes. When introducing any new food, it's really important to do so gradually to avoid stomach upset. We recommend a transition period of about 5-10 days. You'll gradually mix increasing amounts of JustFoodForDogs with your dog's current food until they are fully on the new diet.
